rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the killing of many people, especially in news or historical contexts.

example.english: This massacre reduced the whole village to ruins overnight.
example.traditional: 呢場大屠殺令成個村莊一夜之間變成廢墟。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 daai6 tou4 saat3 ling6 sing4 go3 cyun1 zong1 jat1 je6 zi1 gaan1 bin3 sing4 fai3 heoi1

rows.note: Use this for a one-sided defeat in a game, competition, or other contest rather than for mass killing.

example.english: It was a massacre when we played our opponents yesterday.
example.traditional: 我哋噚日同對手打嗰場波，真係輸到慘敗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 cam4 jat6 tung4 deoi3 sau2 daa2 go2 coeng4 bo1 zan1 hai6 syu1 dou3 caam2 baai6
